outline.course_name: Simulink® for System and Algorithm Modeling

description.text: This two-day course is for engineers who are new to system and algorithm modeling and design validation in Simulink. It demonstrates how to apply basic modeling techniques and tools to develop Simulink block diagrams. Topics include:

bullets.item: Creating and modifying Simulink models and simulating system dynamics
Modeling continuous-time, discrete-time, and hybrid systems
Modifying solver settings for simulation accuracy and speed
Building hierarchy into a Simulink model

Creating reusable model components using subsystems, libraries, and model references
If your application is Signal Processing or Communications, please refer to our Simulink® for Signal Processing course.

section.title: Creating and Simulating a Model
section.objective: Create a simple Simulink model, simulate it, and analyze the results.

bullets.item: Create a Simulink model of the potentiometer system
Simulate the model and analyze results

section.title: Modeling Programming Constructs
section.objective: Model and simulate basic programming constructs in Simulink.

section.title: Modeling Discrete Systems
section.objective: Model and simulate discrete systems in Simulink.

bullets.item: Create a model of a PI controller
Model discrete transfer functions and state space systems

section.title: Modeling Continuous Systems
section.objective: Model and simulate continuous systems in Simulink.

bullets.item: Create a model of a throttle system

section.title: Solver Selection
section.objective: Select a solver that is appropriate for a given Simulink model.

section.title: Developing Model Hierarchy
section.objective: Use subsystems to combine smaller systems into larger systems.

section.title: Modeling Conditionally Executed Algorithms
section.objective: Create subsystems that are executed based on a control signal input.

section.title: Combining Models into Diagrams
section.objective: Use model referencing to combine models.

section.title: Creating Libraries
section.objective: Use libraries to create and distribute custom blocks.

bullets.item: Add a library to the Simulink Library Browser

section.title: Appendix A: MATLAB® Review
section.objective: Review basics of the MATLAB language that are useful when using Simulink.

section.title: Appendix B: Modeling Reference
section.objective: Provides a reference on working with the Simulink interface, including commonly used keyboard and mouse shortcuts.

section.title: Appendix C: Rate Transitions in Multirate Models
section.objective: Discuss intricacies of how data transfer is handled between Simulink blocks that update at different rates.

section.title: Appendix D: Automating Modeling Tasks
section.objective: Automate common modeling and simulation tasks using MATLAB code.
